tutorial.characterTip.quite: You picked my kit: stronger dodges, medkits heal 15 extra, and at 70 AGI Quick and Swift lets the pistol fire twice.
tutorial.characterTip.leon: Leon can lean on his shield. My Agile Survivor perks only apply when I am the operator.
tutorial.level1Clear: Clean work. Fast zombies hate a close blade because the hit can stun them before they get momentum.
tutorial.level2Clear: Good clear. Use the shop terminal if it opens, then we run the final tutorial stage.
tutorial.completeWithHeal: Tutorial complete. Knife fast targets, grenade heavy armor, pistol ranged or screamers, dodge charger rushes, and heal when HP drops or poison lands. Choose your route.
tutorial.completeWithoutHeal: Tutorial complete. Knife fast targets, grenade heavy armor, pistol ranged or screamers, dodge charger rushes, and save medkits for low HP or poison. Choose your route.
tutorial.fastFollowup: Good, it is stunned. One more clean cut before it gets its speed back.
tutorial.fastIntro: Here comes the fast zombie. Use the knife; it is efficient and can stun this one. {tip}
tutorial.heavyGrenade: Heavy zombie ahead. Do not waste the knife on armor; crack it open with a grenade.
tutorial.spitterPistol: Spitter in the lane. Keep distance and use the pistol before acid turns the fight messy.
tutorial.chargerDodge: See that stance? The charger is lined up. Defend now and dodge the rush.
tutorial.chargerFinish: Good read. The rush is spent; use the pistol and finish the charger.
tutorial.chargerBait: Charger lesson. Fire the pistol first; we want it to commit to the rush before you dodge.
tutorial.screamerPistol: Screamer spotted. Delete it with the pistol before it calls another infected into the level.
tutorial.healInterrupt: Your HP is low or status is ticking. Open inventory and use a medkit before the next hit gets expensive.

emergency.sealRelayGatePrompt: A relay gate is stuck half-open. Press X or click before the horde floods the maintenance rail.
levels.1.description.aFastInfectedDartsB: A fast infected darts between abandoned carriages and tests your reflexes.
levels.1.introText: Tutorial 1: fast targets hate close pressure. Knife strikes land cleanly while grenades feel clumsy.
levels.1.completeText: You steady your breathing and find the first survivor cache.
levels.2.description.onePlatedBruteBlock: One plated brute blocks the hall while a ranged mutant spits from the backline.
levels.2.introText: Tutorial 2: heavy targets shrug off knives, and spitters punish careless close combat.
levels.2.completeText: The corridor opens into a supply bay with just enough time to regroup.
levels.3.description.aChargerLinesUpItsR: A charger lines up its rush while a screamer prepares to call the whole station down on you.
levels.3.introText: Tutorial 3: dodging matters. The charger rewards patience, and the screamer must be removed quickly.
levels.3.completeText: Three route beacons flicker to life. Your next decision shapes the build for the run.
levels.4A.description.emergencyEventsEva: Emergency events, evasive fights, and larger agility gains.
levels.4C.description.longerFightsHeavie: Longer fights, heavier enemies, and more coins for the shop.
levels.4A.description.aBrokenMaintenance: A broken maintenance rail flickers back to life while infected flood the side lanes toward your beacon.
levels.4A.introText: Agile route: react fast, delete priority threats, and turn emergency pressure into permanent speed.
levels.4A.text.youRestoreARelaySightModu: You restore a relay sight module and fit it onto the pistol. Laser pistol unlocked.
levels.4A.text.youClearTheBeaconLineAt: You clear the beacon line at full speed. Agility +4.
levels.unknown.completeText.theRouteBeac: The route beacon steadies, and a battered service terminal blinks beside a narrow refuge.
levels.5A.description.stayFastAndRiskyWi: Stay fast and risky with another mobility-heavy route.
levels.5B.description.takeTheBalancedRou: Take the balanced route and split your gains.
levels.5C.description.turnIntoTheTougher: Turn into the tougher route for more pressure and economy.
levels.5A.description.aShatteredUpperWal: A shattered upper walkway forces you across exposed glass and broken guard rails under constant pressure.
levels.5A.introText: Agile route: speed matters, but so does target order. One bad turn here turns momentum into a fall.
levels.5A.text.quiteFindsACompactParrySi: Quite finds a compact parry sidearm in a broken checkpoint locker. It holds 10 shots and cannot be reloaded.
levels.5A.text.youCrossTheCatwalkWithout: You cross the catwalk without losing rhythm. Agility +6.
levels.unknown.completeText.youClearTheB: You clear the broken span and reach the last stairwell above the dead platform lights.
levels.6A.description.theExtractionRelay: The extraction relay is dead, the lights are out, and every second you spend exposed draws another shape through the dark.
levels.6A.introText: Agile finale: hit 70 agility, keep your nerves, and turn the blackout into an advantage before the last sprint.
levels.6A.completeText: You restore the relay, outrun the blackout, and find the quarantine route still sealed ahead.
levels.4B.description.aSupplyPlatformOff: A supply platform offers cleaner sight lines but mixes every threat type together.
levels.4B.introText: Balanced route: no gimmick saves you here. Adapt weapon choice to each enemy.
levels.4B.text.youKeepBothDisciplineAndS: You keep both discipline and speed under pressure. Agility +2, Courage +2.
levels.4B.completeText: The center route stays brutal, but your toolkit grows more reliable.
levels.5B.description.aRuinedCommandNode: A ruined command node forces you to answer ranged threats and charging attacks at the same time.
levels.5B.introText: Balanced route: keep enough coins for the shop, because attrition matters now.
levels.5B.text.aControlledClearHardensBo: A controlled clear hardens both instincts. Agility +2, Courage +2.
levels.5B.completeText: You cut power to the junction and push into the final station block.
levels.6B.description.theBalancedRouteEn: The balanced route ends with every lesson layered into one prolonged fight.
levels.6B.introText: No single weapon solves this room for you.
levels.6B.completeText: You survive the balanced route with a build that can flex both ways, then catch the quarantine gate cycling open.
levels.4C.description.aBarricadeIsBuckli: A barricade is buckling under the weight of the infected, but the supply cache behind it could fund the rest of the run.
levels.4C.introText: Courage route: absorb the pressure, keep the wall standing, and turn the early haul into shop power.
levels.4C.text.theBreachCacheHoldsABigge: The breach cache holds a bigger stack of antique coins than expected.
levels.4C.text.youHoldTheWallThroughThe: You hold the wall through the impact and harden your resolve. Courage +4.
levels.4C.completeText: The barricade finally settles, and the defended supply point is yours to strip clean.
levels.5B.description.takeTheBalancedRou: Take the balanced route and smooth out your build.
levels.5C.description.stayOnTheEndurance: Stay on the endurance line for more pressure and coins.
levels.5D.description.pushIntoABrutalSal: Push into a brutal salvage corridor built around melee pressure and Leon's new relic path.
levels.5C.description.anEngineRoomChokeP: An engine-room choke point turns into a brutal siege where every block and every clean hit has to count.
levels.5C.introText: Courage route: this is where Leon's shield, armour, and crit scaling are supposed to matter.
levels.5C.text.youAnchorTheFurnaceLineAn: You anchor the furnace line and refuse to give ground. Courage +6.
levels.5C.completeText: The engine room falls quiet at last, with only heat shimmer and shield-ring left behind.
levels.5D.description.aCollapsingSalvage: A collapsing salvage line grinds shut around you while heavier infected force every retreat into dead steel.
levels.5D.introText: Courage route: this branch is about surviving the crush, then turning Leon's rescue tool into a real endgame edge.
levels.5D.text.theSalvageBinsStillHideA: The salvage bins still hide a few antique coins worth taking.
levels.5D.text.youKeepThePressMovingUnde: You keep the press moving under impossible pressure. Courage +4.
levels.5D.text.leonTearsARescueAxeFrom: Leon tears a rescue axe from the salvage rack. It can wrench him free when the dead get too close.
levels.unknown.completeText.theSalvageLi: The salvage line sputters out behind you, leaving only a red-lit gate block ahead.
levels.6C.description.theFinalExtraction: The final extraction holdout forces you to answer a full siege package with no wasted actions and no panic.
levels.6C.introText: Courage finale: identify the priority target fast, weather the burst, and let the build you funded carry you home.
levels.6C.completeText: You survive the holdout and reach a quarantine cache stamped with biohazard warnings.
levels.6D.description.theLastCourageEndp: The last Courage endpoint pins you between a jammed blast gate and repeated impact waves that want to drag you under.
levels.6D.introText: Courage finale: hold the line, keep the gate sequence alive, and let Leon's rescue axe turn close calls into openings.
levels.unknown.completeText.youHoldLockj: You hold Lockjaw Gate, survive the final crush, and force the quarantine route open by sheer stubbornness.
levels.7.description.aSealedEmergencyLoc: A sealed emergency locker waits outside the bio-research facility gate.
levels.7.introText: Bonus level: the cache unlocks with a tired hydraulic cough. You grab rifle ammunition and medkits before the final breach.
levels.7.text.theQuarantineCacheGrantsRi: The quarantine cache grants rifle access, 10 rifle rounds, and 3 medkits.
levels.7.completeText: The locker slams shut behind you. Only the bio-research facility gate remains.
levels.8.description.aBiohazardousResear: A biohazardous research lab stretches beyond the quarantine gate, all warning lights and cracked containment glass.
levels.8.introText: The operator forces open the quarantine gate into a bio-research facility. Sirens flood the lab, glass containment tanks split, and something enormous answers from the dark.
levels.8.completeText: Nemesis-T Type collapses under the lab strobes. The facility falls silent, and the mission is finally over.
